evidencePolicy: Ideas are brainstorming candidates. Registry 404 means no registration record, not guaranteed registrar eligibility or standard pricing. .es remains unverified until a registry or registrar check confirms it. A favorite is not approval to register or launch.

priceSource.scope: Standard extension tariffs, not name-specific quotes

esVerificationLimit: Red.es has no public RDAP entry in the IANA bootstrap. Direct WHOIS requires authorized IP access; available registrar lookups require credentials. No DNS-only availability inference is used.
brandReviewScope: Preliminary web spot-checks, concentrated on shortlisted ideas. Not a complete brand or trademark clearance. Registry availability is assessed independently.
